updates.notes: SelectedFileInput consumes ranged XFile.openRead. OH selection now carries metadata only, UriXFile reads at most one MiB via open/readChunk/close, validates ranges and premature EOF, and uses finally for token closure. Native inputs are serialized and teardown drains in-flight operations then closes descriptors. readAsBytes still collects all data. Failed cleanup can replace the primary Dart exception in the shown implementation; preserving that exception is recommended hardening. Source length is snapshotted; mutation/grant persistence and memory/descriptor behavior require runtime checks. Generated Dart/ArkTS FileResponse fields remove bytes together. Later 4250747263 changes only the Android picker route in shared input, not these OH mechanisms.
